decisions.reason: As a long-established German wholesale supplier, the firm would usually keep a core print-finishing machine in the range unless sales were clearly weak, though overlap with the more advanced binder raises some discontinuation risk.
A fully automatic perfect binder fits a specialized professional portfolio and is likely worth keeping as a higher-end offering despite some uncertainty from the missing later website evidence.
The booklet maker complements the binder products and broadens the finishing line, so a mature wholesaler would generally keep it on the market absent clear signs of failure.
